category_title: Young children with persistent challenging behaviors and communication delays
minimal_context: The adult is taking Kayden to the grocery store to run errands after picking him up from childcare.

dialogue.message: Okay Kayden, I picked you up from childcare. Now we are going to run some errands and go grocery shopping.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We just need to get a few things from the store.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Crying gets louder as they pull into the store parking lot)

dialogue.speaker: student

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Okay Kayden, I picked you up from childcare. Now we are going to run some errands and go grocery shopping.

STUDENT: (Starts crying in the car seat)

TUTOR: We just need to get a few things from the store.

STUDENT: (Crying gets louder as they pull into the store parking lot)

TUTOR: Let's go inside now.

STUDENT: (Spends the time screaming and crying continuously while being taken into the grocery store)

task.content: Running errands, such as grocery shopping

context.materials: Small bag in the car, snacks, toys, books, visual supports
context.time_context: On her way home after picking up Kayden from childcare

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Being told they will be running errands

behavior_patterns.condition: During the time spent running errands after childcare
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Spends much of the time screaming and crying
